description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including specific determinations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances for multiple land parcels in Colombo District. It contains detailed schedules with land ownership information, property boundaries, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
